senses.gloss:
bh. The 24th consonant, and as-
pirate of the preceding.

भ (भं) 1.
n. A star; a bee; error; a
planet.
m. Shukra, regent of
Venus.
f. (भा) Light, lustre.
f. (भी) Fear.

भा (ल) भाति 2.
m. To shine; to be
beautiful; to be pleased; to
blow; to be. With आ to flash;
with प्र or वि to shine brightly.

भा (भा) 1.
f. Light; beauty; shadow
of a gnomon.
m. The sun.
